title: Demand board and PMO Teams product closure — verification revision 2
decision: Accept revision 2: keep the same P0/P1 scope and correct T-002 verification to build Core before freshness-guarded tests and scan the actual public adapter call syntax.
acceptance: The unfinished Demand/Leader Topic tasks transferred from f-29z8fg88s are either closed by a reviewed P0/P1 task or explicitly recorded as transferred history.

PMO Teams can observe Projects, Workspaces, Topics, Agents, Sessions, Demands and recent activity; inspect exact identities; create/update/link/assign/start/handoff Demand work through typed JSON receipts.

Board treats Demand as the only primary card, supports zero or multiple Sessions, a fixed detail workspace, routing queue, explicit lifecycle changes, deletion confirmation, and shared filesystem/CUI facts.
Plugin contributions are discoverable and versioned, activation and teardown are reversible, failures preserve completed steps, and RSI improvement uses bounded evidence/replay before activation.
P2/P3 scope is held in a separate Feature and does not widen this closure.
